{{Top|leg}}
The '''MDS-500''' was a durable [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] produced during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], and many examples survived into the [[New Republic era]]. In one datapad of this model, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] found an interactive [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] process by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] had already begun.
